input.body:
Hi Leo,

I have granted you access to the following groups that Priya Nair holds and you did not previously have:
- SYN-GRP-CONFLUENCE-FINANCE (Confluence finance space)
- SYN-GRP-FINREP-READ (Finance Reports readers)
- SYN-GRP-JIRA-WRITE (Jira editors)

The following two groups require your manager's approval before granting, so I have noted them for review:
- SYN-GRP-FINREP-WRITE (Finance Reports editors)
- SYN-GRP-PAYROLL-ADMIN (Payroll administrators)

I will update you once these are approved or if further steps are needed.

Best regards,
IT Access Desk
